# wso2is_custom_authenticator (Resource)

Manages a custom local authenticator (WSO2 IS 7.1 and later). A custom authenticator is a login step that your own HTTPS service performs, and that WSO2 calls during login. To use it, add it to an application's `authentication_sequence` with `idp = "LOCAL"` and `authenticator = <name>`. Custom federated authenticators work differently: you set them up on `wso2is_identity_provider` with an endpoint. To import, use the authenticator name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_custom_authenticator" "branch_pin" {
  name                         = "custom-branch-pin"
  display_name                 = "Branch PIN"
  authentication_type          = "VERIFICATION"
  endpoint_uri                 = "https://pin.example.com/authenticate"
  endpoint_authentication_type = "BEARER"
  endpoint_authentication_properties = {
    accessToken = var.pin_service_token
  }
}

variable "pin_service_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown on the login page.
- `endpoint_authentication_type` (String) How WSO2 signs in to the service. The allowed values are `NONE`, `BASIC`, `BEARER` and `API_KEY`.
- `endpoint_uri` (String) HTTPS endpoint of the authentication service.
- `name` (String) The authenticator name. It must start with `custom-`. Changing the name replaces the authenticator.

### Optional

- `authentication_type` (String) `IDENTIFICATION` (the service identifies the user, for a first step) or `VERIFICATION` (it verifies an already identified user, for later steps). Changing it replaces the authenticator.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the authenticator can be used. The default is `true`.
- `endpoint_authentication_properties` (Map of String, Sensitive) The credentials for the service. Use `username` and `password`, `accessToken`, or `header` and `value`, to match `endpoint_authentication_type`. The server never returns these values.
- `image_url` (String) Logo URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Authenticator ID (base64url of the name).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_custom_authenticator.branch_pin custom-branch-pin
```
